title.zh: 气象看板：实况、预报和更新时间
title.en: Weather dashboards: observations, forecasts and update times

summary.en: Apply frontend experience to forecast interfaces: distinguish observations from forecasts, stale responses from current ones, and unavailable data from zero.
summary.zh: 把前端经验延伸到预测界面：区分实况与预报、旧响应与当前结果，也区分缺失与零值。

basis.en: Design proposals based on the existing weather-fallback and request-lifecycle notes, with ERA5 terminology checked against its documentation. This is a design note, not a deployed weather service.
basis.zh: 从已有天气定位回退、请求生命周期笔记延伸的设计方案，数据性质参照 ERA5 文档。本篇是设计笔记，尚未部署新的气象业务服务。

title.en: 01 / Put three times beside the value
title.zh: 01 / 数值旁边，放对三个时间

paragraphs.en: A number needs context: when the forecast was issued, which time it describes, and when the interface refreshed. A recent HTTP response may still contain an old forecast. Put the unit and product type beside the value rather than hiding them in a tooltip.
paragraphs.zh: 一个数值要说清预报何时发出、描述哪个时刻、页面何时刷新。接口刚刚响应，不等于预报刚刚更新。单位与产品类型应紧邻数值，不要只藏在悬浮提示里。

paragraphs.en: Observation, forecast and reanalysis need separate labels. If a demo uses synthetic data, place that label beside the chart. A chart with a continuous curve should not silently connect periods where the source is unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 实况、预报、再分析需要分别标注；演示若用合成数据，就在图表旁说明。数据来源中断时，连续曲线不应悄悄跨过空缺。

title.zh: 02 / 先规定响应，再设计动效

paragraphs.en: This synthetic JSON illustrates field names only. Its timestamps and values are not actual observations or forecasts. A real response also needs a schema version and server-side validation.
paragraphs.zh: 下面的合成 JSON 只说明字段含义，时间与数值不是实际观测或预报。真实接口还需要版本约定与服务端校验。

title.en: 03 / Changing a site also changes the request scope
title.zh: 03 / 切换站点，也切换请求归属

paragraphs.en: When a reader moves from site A to site B, invalidate A’s pending request before rendering B. Check site, product, horizon and request generation before writing a response. AbortController can reduce work, but ownership checks still protect against late responses.
paragraphs.zh: 读者从 A 站切到 B 站时，先使 A 的待返回请求失效。写入结果前，核对站点、产品、跨度和请求代次。AbortController 可以减少无效工作，但仍要检查迟到响应的归属。

paragraphs.en: If retaining an older curve during refresh, label it with its original site and issue time. Do not display an old A curve under a new B title. A loading skeleton is often clearer when context has changed.
paragraphs.zh: 刷新时若保留旧曲线，必须保留旧站点与发出时间。不能在 B 的标题下显示 A 的曲线。上下文已变时，使用加载占位往往更清楚。

title.zh: 04 / 状态先讲清，动画再补充

bullets.en: Loading: reserve chart height and preserve keyboard focus. Empty: explain that the time range has no records. Error: offer a retry without discarding the chosen site.
bullets.zh: 加载：预留图表高度，保留键盘焦点。空结果：说明该时间段无记录。失败：提供重试，并保留已选站点。

bullets.en: Stale or partial: show the source and delay, and distinguish a partial response from a complete result. Missing values remain null instead of becoming zero.
bullets.zh: 过期或部分缺失：标出来源与延迟，区分部分返回和完整结果。缺失值保留 null，不转换成零。

bullets.en: Use a short transition to explain a changed filter; respect reduced-motion settings. A textual summary and a small table make the chart usable without color or animation.
bullets.zh: 用短过渡解释筛选变化，并遵守减少动画设置。补上文字摘要和小表格，让信息不依赖颜色或动画才能理解。

title.en: 05 / The checks I would run first

paragraphs.en: Proposed checks: delay A until after B; return an old issue time in a fresh response; omit part of the series; change the horizon during loading; navigate by keyboard at phone width. The expected result should be written before the implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 建议先验证：A 响应晚于 B；新响应里带旧预报；序列缺一段；加载时切换跨度；手机宽度下只用键盘操作。每种情况先写预期行为，再写实现。

paragraphs.en: A reliable display can help users inspect evidence. It cannot establish forecast accuracy by itself; that requires the separate evaluation protocol and prediction records.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的展示帮助读者检查证据，但界面本身不能证明预测准确，仍需要独立评估方案与预测明细。
